newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices steady on low volumes.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices steady on low volumes.

text.p: India's castorseed December delivery prices were steady at 1,127/1,129 rupees per quintal on Friday on narrow trade, dealers said.
"Trading volumes were low and key players kept away, awaiting maturity of the September delivery," one dealer said.
He said as soon as "September delivery went off the board trading activity will improve for December delivery".
Groundnut oil eased to 423/424 rupees per 10 kg from 426/427 rupees on sluggish physical demand and unloading by stockists following higher supplies of imported palm oil.
In Rajkot, spot oil was quoted at 660/665 rupees per 15 kg.
